summary: Supermarket rooftop car park in West End, ringed by homes and apartments.
reasons: Homes and apartments within 25 to 35 m
Rooftop car park, likely gated or ticketed
Nearest dwelling over 10 m from the middle

best_section.where: Middle of the rooftop car park, away from the edges

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings sit 24 m (house), 32 m (apartments) and more all round, so a van is overlooked from several sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Ring is on a large flat roof, so it is parking deck for a shop. Lift gates mapped 80 to 100 m away suggest barrier control, and van height clearance is unknown.
drivers.traffic: Quiet at night once the shop closes; Sir William MacGregor Drive and the town centre are beyond the buildings.
drivers.convention: Shopper parking with no sign of camping; a nearby car park is mapped as paid.

flags: Lift gates mapped nearby; may close or charge overnight
Slope about 5% mean around the pin, but the roof deck itself looks flat
Height barrier or ramp access unknown
sun_shade: Open roof with no cover, full sun from all sides.
cannot_judge: Fees and signs on the deck
